headline: Portfolio Outperformance vs. SPY YTD
summary: As of July 14, 2026, the portfolio set is outperforming the SPY benchmark with an average return of 18.35% compared to SPY's 11.01%. This results in an average alpha of 7.34%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has delivered a remarkable return of 46.35%, significantly contributing to the overall outperformance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Google 100', has returned 10.89%, still above the benchmark but less impactful. This outperformance is particularly relevant during periods of market stress and uncertainty, providing a clearer picture of the portfolios' resilience. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
